projects.title: Bangers N Mash — test case management
projects.tagline: Test case management built for one IT team — UAT, regression, and vendor case studies, all in one place.
projects.description: Everstory Partners' IT team runs testing across a stack of vendor products — user acceptance testing, regression cycles, case studies — and it lived scattered across spreadsheets and inboxes. Bangers N Mash puts it in one place: author test cases, track results across cycles, and disseminate findings to the people who need them.

projects.title: Third Brain OS
projects.tagline: Takes the mental load off families — a shared brain for managing the chaos of life.
projects.description: Third Brain OS is Second 9 Labs' answer to the mental load of family life — the invisible work of remembering, planning, and keeping everyone's schedules, lists, and logistics straight. It's a shared brain for the household, built to lift that load off the people carrying it and make the chaos of life feel manageable.

projects.title: Park PPA — digital parking payments
projects.tagline: Collect parking-lease payments digitally — the custom payment app the Pittsburgh Parking Authority didn't have.
projects.description: A custom application that lets a parking authority collect lease payments online — built to close the gap the Pittsburgh Parking Authority (PPA) had: no digital, app-based way to take payments. Pitched to PPA as a turnkey solution; this is the working build.

projects.title: MC Peels — the grocery concierge
projects.tagline: Takes the grocery-list translation off your plate — say what you want to eat, get a checkout-ready cart already filtered to your family's diet.
projects.description: MC Peels is a household grocery concierge: say what you want in plain language and it builds a ready-to-checkout Instacart or Kroger cart, automatically filtered to your family's standing dietary rules. Save a recipe from TikTok or Pinterest, and once a household has saved enough of one cuisine, MC Peels mints a themed AI-designed kitchen around it — a name, a voice, a palette, all its own.
